title: Gap volley
subtitle: Design a clear signal, a reachable response, and a useful opening.
variant: Projectile wall with a safe gap
summary: The boss fires a broad volley with one readable opening that the player can reach in time.
overview: A gap volley covers most of a lane while preserving a deliberate safe route. It works when the opening is shown before motion begins, stays wider than the player, and moves at a speed the camera can communicate.
learning: Tune the signal, the projectile lanes and safe gap, response time, and recovery.

demo.title: Test the pattern
phaseDescriptions: The future lanes appear and one safe gap remains open.
The wall advances while the player aligns with the gap.
The projectiles clear and both sides prepare the next arrangement.
demo.reducedMotion: Autoplay is disabled by the reduced-motion setting. Use the timeline slider to inspect the loop.
demo.diagramDescription: A looping diagram of gap volley. The boss signals the pattern, the player responds, and both return smoothly to their starting positions.

steps.title: Is the signal specific?
steps.body: Preview the whole wall, especially the gap, before projectiles block the view.

steps.title: Is the response reachable?
steps.body: Measure gap width against the full collision shape and lateral travel time.

steps.title: Is the opening useful?
steps.body: Use the next pause to reset spacing or let the player attack.

mistakes.title: Hidden rule
mistakes.body: If the signal does not reveal the projectile lanes and safe gap, the hit feels arbitrary.

mistakes.title: Wrong scale
mistakes.body: If timing is tested only at one upgrade level, the pattern can become trivial or unavoidable.

designNotes.title: Match visuals and collision
designNotes.body: The visible threat must match the active hitbox in space and time.

designNotes.title: Start with ordinary abilities
designNotes.body: Keep one response available with abilities the player already has.

designNotes.title: Retest upgrades
designNotes.body: Check movement, range, damage, and invulnerability against every phase.

story.title: Make the arena support the rule
story.body: Keep the incoming edge on camera and avoid effects that visually close the gap.

adaptation.title: Respect player upgrades
adaptation.body: Test the strongest available build. If an attack is blocked, make the immunity clear and preserve another useful response.

distinction.title: Name the exact pattern
distinction.body: A gap volley asks the player to find a route through a formation, not dodge isolated shots.

lensNotes.body: The cue reveals what will happen, where, and when.
The shape of danger defines the player’s possible routes.
A readable response turns pressure into a decision.
The pattern tests skills taught before this encounter.

examples.body: Dense feather rows remain readable because their rhythm and openings can be seen before contact.
Layered projectile walls use depth and color to preserve safe spacing inside a 3D arena.
Rows of bullets sweep downward with deliberately offset openings. Alternating the gap position makes the player read each row instead of holding one safe lane.
